content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Compliance Review & Sales Performance Alignment
agenda_items: Upcoming training needs for sales team on updated compliance protocols
Review of current compliance adherence in travel package sales

key_decisions: Implement bi-weekly compliance checkpoints for all international sales deals.
Mandatory refresher training on GDPR and local data privacy laws for all sales personnel to be completed within the next 4 weeks.
Form a cross-functional task force to assess market entry feasibility for the APAC region within the next 3 months.
